string.value: Please refrain from using foul language in this game.
If you target another user for verbal or other forms of abuse within the game, your access to the game will be limited.
The gamemaster will never ask for password or any other form of personal information.
Please be careful not to let anyone else know your password.
If you find any bugs or have trouble playing the game, send feedback through the 'submit bugs or feedback' section on the website.
If you commit an illegal act within the game, your access to the game will be limited.
If you use any hacking programs or engage in any activity that may be deemed illegal, your access to the game will be limited.
You can use the system option at menu to change your sound settings.
Use the game option at menu to change settings for chatting, trade request, whisper, and others.
Type '/?' on the textbox to see a list of commands available by typing '/'.
If the cash equipment item is equipped on top of the regular equipment item, the abilities of the regular items will stay put.
To prevent hacking, you should think twice before opening an unknown attachment file from a messenger or an email.
Mesos can be exchanged for goods and services.
Use the game option at menu to disable megaphones, mapletips, or darken your chat bar.
Use HotKey's (I,E,S,K,W,M,R,H) to conveniently access all menus quickly.
To designate an item as a HotKey, drag the item onto the quick slot.
Look for hidden portals all around the map.
Press F1~F7 to make various facial expressions.
Use the portal on the field to move on to a different area.
The portals that allow you to move on to a different area will be displayed on the minimap as a blue dot.
Once you leave the Maple Island, there's no turning back.
Click on 'Detail' on the stat window(default key S), to take a detailed look at your character stats.
Other characters around you will be displayed on the minimap as red dots.
Stand still for a period of time to slowly regain health.
To pick up an item, press 'Z' or '0' on the number pad.
Press CTRL to attack, ALT to jump, unless of course you changed your key settings.
Visit different stores to purchase equipment and potions necessary for your journey.
Assign your 5 ability points(AP) via the stat window(Default S) whenever your character levels up
Once you have made the 1st job advancement, you can't change to another class.
To equip an item, open your inventory, navigate to the equipment tab and double click the item.
Press 'W' to look at the world map.
Press 'E' to look at your equipment window.
Press 'I' to open your inventory.
Press 'M' to look at the minimap.
Press 'K' to look at your skill window.
Press 'S' to look at your character stats.
To create a party, open your buddylist(Default R), click the party tab and click create.
If the party leader wants to invite a user to the party, type '/partyinvite character-name' in the textbox.
If the party leader wants to expel a party member, type '/partyexpel'.
To leave the party, type '/leaveparty'.
To look at your party's information, type '/partyinfo'.
To raise or drop someone's fame level, right-click on the user then click "Personal Info," then hit the up or down arrow besides their fame.
You can raise or drop someone's fame level once a day.
You can raise or drop a particular user's fame level once a month.
Every town features stores where you can purchase potions.
Some items have gender, job and fame limitations. Please be aware of this before purchasing.
Once you have made the 1st job advancement, you can't change to another class.
Please be aware that you will lose EXP after choosing a job.
Quests are a great way to obtain some unique items that aren't available in stores.
You will gain more inventory slots after job advancements. How many and which tab depends on your job.
You will not earn missed skill points once you advance if you have over levelled your character. Please keep this in mind.
Type '/trade character-name' to request a trade with a character.
To become a magician, head to Ellinia at level 8 with at least 20 INT.
To create a party, open your buddylist(Default R), click the party tab and click create.
If the party leader wants to invite a user to the party, type '/partyinvite character-name' in the textbox.
If the party leader wants to expel a party member, type '/partyexpel'.
To leave the party, type '/leaveparty'.
To look at your party's information, type '/partyinfo'.
To raise or drop someone's fame level, right-click on the user then click "Personal Info," then hit the up or down arrow besides their fame.
You can raise or drop someone's fame level once a day.
You can raise or drop a particular user's fame level once a month.
Job advancements can be made in their corresponding towns, Archers -Henesys, Thieves - Kerning City, Magicians - Ellinia, Warriors - Perion.
Passive skills work automatically after putting skill points into them.
To use an active skill, drag it out of the skill window and put it onto your hotkey of choice.
Each large town sells different types of equipment.
You will not earn missed skill points once you advance if you have over levelled your character. Please keep this in mind.
After making your job advancement, you will gain 3 skill points(SP) on every level up.
Skill points can be assigned on your skill window.
Be aware of the powerful monsters that lurk in Sleepywood dungeon!
Defeating more powerful foes may yield an item you can't buy in stores.
Mana points(MP) will slowly recover after a certain period of time.
Skill that require mana points(MP) will not work if you run out, keep this in mind!
Type '/trade character-name' to request a trade with a user.
Use return scrolls to quickly get back to a town. You can buy these in potion stores.
Throwing stars will not be removed after they run out, you just need to recharge them at an armour store.
You can recharge throwing stars at any armour store.
You can make the second job advancement at level 30, provided you chose a 1st job.
Skill points earned up to level 30 must be used in first job skills.
You need to use up all of the skill points earned up to level 30 before making the second job advancement.
Some skills will cancel each other out.
Use various scrolls to improve your equipment.
There's a 24-Hr store available deep in the Sleepywood dungeon where you can purchase more powerful potions.
When making the 2nd job advancement, Bowmen have 2 paths available. These are Hunter and Crossbow Man.
When making the 2nd job adv., the bowman need to choose one of these two jobs available: Hunter or Crossbow man.
When making the 2nd job advancement, Magicians have 3 paths available. These are Cleric, Wizard-Fire/Poison and Wizard-Ice/Lightning.
When making the 2nd job adv, Thieves have 2 paths available. These are Bandit and Assassin.
Some quests and items require a certain level of fame.
The 3rd job advancement is available at level 70, as long as you made the second job advancement.
Don't use your skill points earned after level 70 until you have made the 3rd job advancement.
You need to use all of your skill points(SP) earned until 70 in order to make the 3rd job advancement.
Some quests are repeatable.
Use the sauna at Sleepywood Hotel to recover your HP and MP faster and to buy potions.
2nd job magicians get some elemental skills. These work best on certain types of monsters.
